service.name: Beatles sing-along duo
service.serviceType: A Beatles sing-along for parties, company events, weddings, community programs and senior living
service.description: Your Bird Can Sing is a Beatles sing-along led by two musicians. The duo plays the songs and leads the audience through them, and it books as one duo across the Denver area, the Front Range and the mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What is Your Bird Can Sing?
faqs.a: A Beatles sing-along led by two musicians, booked through Signet Artists in Denver, for family parties, company events, weddings, community programs and senior living.

faqs.q: Is this a Beatles tribute band?
faqs.a: No. Two musicians play the Beatles songbook as themselves and lead the audience through the songs.

faqs.q: Does anyone need to know the words?
faqs.a: No. Everyone gets a lyric booklet and the duo leads the melody, so anyone who wants to sing can, and anyone who would rather sit and listen is welcome to.
One set of 45 to 60 minutes, or two shorter sets with a break. Requests are welcome.

faqs.q: What do we need to have ready?
faqs.a: About 8 by 6 feet of floor and one standard outlet. The duo brings sound support that's the right size for the venue, so you don't need a system of your own, and the musicians arrive about an hour before the start. Outdoors it needs shade over the musicians and an outlet within reach, and what happens if it rains is on the technical page.

About as loud as a conversation. People at the back hear the melody and the front table can keep talking. The duo sets the volume to the space and the crowd, so in a small space it plays with no amplification at all, and in a courtyard it plays louder to reach the back.

faqs.q: Can we book it every month?
faqs.a: Yes. It books as a standing date, the same afternoon each month or every other week, on one contract with one personal contact for the whole run, and the set changes from visit to visit.

faqs.q: Do you have a certificate of insurance and a W-9?
faqs.a: Yes. Both come in the same email as the contract, with an invoice that matches your purchase order, so a business office can set the vendor up before the date.
